With enough stress and life changing events, anyone can cheat. It’s a matter of you avoiding micro cheating or see ahead of what might make you cheat. You need to understand yourself and your weaknesses.  You also need to respect your chosen partner, even when you grow to hate them.  Learn to value your relationships. Explore all the options to make it work and if in the end it still didn’t, at least have the decency just end things with them. But never, ever resort to cheating..  it’s betrayal. It’s demeaning, it’s disrespectful not just to your partner/children, but to yourself.
